title: Let God the Maker's Name
description: Let God the Maker's Name in Tonic Solfa to ST. BRIDE, doh is Bb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 2 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for his Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707), Book III, prepared for the Lord's Supper, hymn 31, headed “2d. S. M”.
Watts' hymns were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Short Metre (6.6.8.6). This page sets the words to ST. BRIDE; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Let God the Mak-er's name Have ho-nour, love and fear, To God the Sa-viour pay the same, And God the Com-fort-er.

lines: To God the Saviour pay the same,
The Son of thy eternal love

source: Isaac Watts, Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to ST. BRIDE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
